conviction_note: Heiwado will almost certainly miss its own H1 plan. Q2 needed OP +11% YoY and the monthly sales series slowed, so I sum −1.6. I emit −1.2: the street's full-year number is already 5.6% below the company's, the stock fell 5% this week with its supermarket peers, and Heiwado released intraday at 13:30 on five recent prints, which would put much of the reaction outside a close→next-open window.
bar: Company H1 (Feb 21–Aug 20, 2026) guidance from the Q1 決算短信: revenue ¥234,000m, OP ¥6,900m, ordinary ¥7,200m, NP ¥5,000m, unrevised as of 2026-10-01 (https://www.nikkei.com/markets/ir/irftp/data/tdnr/tdnetg3/20260625/fzrtmk/140120260623577308.pdf). print_vs_bar_pct is my H1 OP estimate (~¥6,150m, range 5,800–6,500) against the ¥6,900m guide. A second bar exists for the full year: IFIS consensus has FY OP at ¥13,500m against the company's ¥14,300m, and ordinary at ¥14,700m against ¥15,200m, cut from ¥15,050m four weeks ago (https://kabuyoho.ifis.co.jp/index.php?action=tp1&sa=report&bcode=8276).
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register as of 2026-09-29: 0.0%, no holder at or above 0.5%, change 0.0 (baseline; https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html). Margin balances on kabutan for the week of 2026-09-25: sell 32,900 shares, buy 19,000, 信用倍率 0.58 (https://kabutan.jp/stock/kabuka?code=8276&ashi=shin). That ratio is an artefact of the 株主優待 cross trade, not squeeze fuel. The short side was 2,130,500 shares in mid-August around the Aug 20 record date and has since unwound to 32,900, about 0.06% of 51.5m shares and well under one day's volume. So the baseline's +0.118 margin_overhang lean is noise. There is no option skew in Japan. Run-up is −4.24% over 20 days and −3.95% over 5 days, and the week to 10/01 was −4.96%. Peers fell in the same week (closes from 9/25 to 10/01): Hallows 3920→3720, Fuji 2036→2000, Izumi 983→953, AEON 1300→1261. The TOPIX ETF was flat. So the drawdown is sector-wide, not name-specific informed selling.

findings.finding: Heiwado will miss its own H1 OP plan by about 10–15% (≈¥6,150m against ¥6,900m) and will report Q2 (Jun–Aug) OP down YoY. Hitting the plan needed Q2 OP of ¥4,329m, +11% on last year's ¥3,889m. Instead, standalone existing-store sales slowed from 102.4 in Q1 to about 101.7 (Jun 103.0 / Jul 100.4 / Aug 101.6, July the weakest in 13 months), all-store from 104.1 to 103.2, after a Q1 in which a 0.4pt gross-margin cut and +5.7% personnel cost already took OP down 12.7%. The H1 NP shortfall against ¥5,000m will look larger still, probably 25–35%, because Q1's consolidated effective tax rate was 55% (¥1,492m on ¥2,702m). That headline (最終益) adds to the same release.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The stock has fallen after the last five prints, measured by me from Yahoo daily bars at kabutan's TDnet timestamps. FY2026.02 H1 (2025-10-02, 13:30): OP ¥6,833m against a ¥7,100m guide, a 3.8% miss with the FY guide kept, and the stock fell 4.18% that day. Q3 (2025-12-25, 13:30): −3.28%. FY (2026-04-02, 13:30): −2.17% that day, −4.22% to the next close. Q1 (2026-06-25, 15:30): gap −5.35% next open, −4.14% close to close. The prints before that were mixed or positive: H1 2024 −0.2%, Q1 2024 gap +8.6%.
findings.why_not_priced: The street tracks the full year, not H1, and has cut it only to FY OP ¥13,500m. That still leaves H2 room to grow about 8–16%, and nothing published puts Q2 itself below last year. If the market had priced a Q2 decline, I would expect the 5-day underperformance to exceed the peer group's, and it does not: Heiwado fell about 4.9% while Hallows fell about 5.1%. I would also expect consensus to sit near ¥13,000m. When this name misses its own plan, kabutan's automatic '下振れ着地' headline has been sold every time in the last year, including a smaller 3.8% miss last October.
findings.independence: The Q1 決算短信 is a separate document and supplies the starting point: Q1 OP ¥2,571m (−12.7%), 37% of the H1 plan, and a 55% tax rate (https://www.nikkei.com/markets/ir/irftp/data/tdnr/tdnetg3/20260625/fzrtmk/140120260623577308.pdf). The Q1 営業概況 supplies the 0.4pt gross-margin fall and the +5.7% personnel cost (https://www.heiwado.jp/assets/img/pages/ir/result/summary/2027/q1_gaikyo.pdf). One read cuts the other way: peer ハローズ reported a Q2 ordinary profit recovery of +5.7% on 2026-09-25 after a weak Q1 and fell only about 1% (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=2742&b=k202609250009). That is why the range runs to +1.0.

searched_and_found_nothing: 業績予想の修正 / 配当予想の修正 for 8276 since Q1: none on the kabutan disclosure list (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=8276), so the H1 number is not pre-released.

Event date: the company IR page shows 次回の決算発表日 2026年10月1日（木）(https://www.heiwado.jp/ir/), so the date has not moved. The release time is not stated. The 2024-10 to 2026-04 prints went out at 13:30 intraday; Q1 2026-06-25 went out at 15:30 (kabutan TDnet timestamps, https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=8276&nmode=0&date=20251000).
Capital return: the H1 2024 print came with a 自己株式の消却 notice (2024-10-03 13:30). I found no buyback or cancellation signal for this print and did not size one.

Store and price news for September 2026 (closures, 値下げ campaigns): only routine 店休日 lists and a Takaoka opening in late November, nothing material (https://shiga2.jp/heiwado-shiga-202610-closed/shiga2/).
Sell-side H1 consensus: not published. IFIS shows only full-year consensus and a June note from a large Japanese broker cutting its target to ¥2,800 and keeping a mildly bullish rating.
Disclosed shorts: zero on the JPX register, nothing above the 0.5% threshold.
baseline_tension: The finding is negative and so is the tape: run-up −4.2% over 20 days, the peer group sold off this week, and the street's full-year number is already below the company's. The finding is therefore only partly ahead of the price. What it adds is that Q2 is likely down YoY, not merely below plan. The baseline's mildly positive lean (+0.33) rests on a 優待-distorted margin ratio and I give it no weight.
lessons_applied: researcher_japan/LESSONS.md holds no rules yet (no Japanese run has resolved), so it gave me nothing to apply.
